s: Din hachatzerot happetuchot zo lezo ubo h' seipim: g' chatzerot happetuchot zo lezo, upetuchot kullan gam ken lemaboy o lirshut harabbim, veereba kol achat mehachitzonot im haemtzait, vehachitzonot lo erebu zo im zo — hare hachitzonot asurot zo im zo, lehotzi kelim sheshshabetu babbattim mizzo lezo derek haemtzait, vehaemtzait mutteret im kol achat mehen vehen muttarot immah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheemtzait notna eruba bezo veeruba bezo, sheaz diyyure haemtzait bachitzonot, shehaerub hu mishshum dira, veen diyyure hachitzonim baemtzait, shehare en eruban bah. O apillu natenu hachitzonot eruban baemtzait leareb immah, ella shello netanuhu shettehen bebayit echad shebbaemtzai, ella zo notna bebayit zeh vezo notna bebayit acher shebbaemtzait, sheaz gam ken lo nitchabberu diyyure hachitzonot zo im zo, sheddiyyure zo hem bebayit zeh vediyyure zo bezeh, velaken hen asurot zo al zo. Abal im netanuhu bebayit echad baemtzait — hare nitchabberu diyyure sheloshtan bebayit zeh, umeorabot hen, vekullan muttarot zo im zo:

B' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo, vechitzona petucha lemaboy, upenimit lechitzona velo lemaboy, veal yede kak yesh lah derisat haregel al hachitzona, sheen lah derek latzet lemaboy ella derek hachitzona: ereba penimit leatzmah vehachitzona lo ereba kelal, o sheereba veen erubah moil, kegon sheshshakach echad meanshe hechatzer velo ereb im bene hechatzer, shehu oser alehem hechatzer ad sheyyebattel reshuto, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"p — hare happenimit mutteret lehotzi lachatzerah kelim sheshshabetu babbattim, veen hachitzona oseret aleha, hoil veyesh mechitztza benehen veen lachitzona derisat haregel aleha. Ereba chitzona leatzmah velo ereba happenimit kelal, o sheshshakach echad min happenimit velo ereb — shettehen asurot, shekkevan sheppenimit asura bachatzerah veyesh lah derisat haregel al hachitzona, oseret otah, sheregel haasura bimqomah oseret shello bimqomah kesheyyesh lah sham derisat haregel. Ereba kol achat leatzmah — kol achat mutteret bachatzerah, veen happenimit oseret al hachitzona, ap al pi shello ereba immah, hoil vehi mutteret bachatzerah, veregel hammutteret bimqomah enah oseret shello bimqomah:

Erebu happenimit vehachitzona beyachad venatenu eruban bappenimit, veshakach echad min happenimit velo ereb — shettehen asurot, shekkevan shehappenimit asura bachatzera, oseret gam hachitzona sheyyesh lah aleha derisat haregel. Abal im shakach echad min hachitzona velo ereb — chitzona asura upenimit mutteret, dekevan sheerubah etzlah, veen lachitzona derisat haregel aleha ella bishbil erubah shemmargilah letokah, tesalleqennah mealeha vetishshaer lebaddah beerubah sheetzlah, vetihyeh mutteret. Abal im natenu eruban bachitzona, apillu shakach echad min hachitzona velo ereb — shettehen asurot, sheap im happenimit tesalleq et hachitzona mealeha, hare en erubah etzlah, ubammeh yitarebu diyyureha:

Im yachid dar bappenimit veyachid bachitzona, o apillu shenayim darim bachitzona veerebu benehem — en hayyachid shebbappenimit oser al hachitzona ap al pi shello erebu yachad, hoil vehi regel hammutteret bimqomah, sheen sham mi sheyyeesor alayv. Vehu haddin rabbim shehem keyachid, sheenan oserim zeh al zeh veenan tzerikim leareb benehen, kegon haab im banayv shemmeqabbelim mimmennu peras, vekol kayyotze bahem mimmah shennitbaer besimman sh"a:

Veken g' chatzerot zo lipnim mizzo veyachid bekol achat, ap al pi sheshshenayim happenimim oberim al hachitzona — enan oserim aleha, mippene shehi regel hammutteret bimqomah. Veim hayu shenayim bashshelishit happenimit velo erebu benehem — oserim al haychidim shebbaemtzait veshebbachitzona, mippene shehi regel haasura bimqomah:
